For the first topic today- Fashion is an evolving beast with the fashionistas of the world endlessly attempting to create impossibly fabulous and unique new outfits for fashion shows. A commonly seen element of such outfits is that they’re often impractical, unwieldy and, to the layperson, hilariously bizarre looking. So why don’t fashion shows just show off clothes people might actually want to wear, instead of going with outlandish outfits?

Next up we have the absolutely bizarre story of one of the greatest domain heists of all time, the bizarre story of the cure for the living dead, that time the U.S. tried to make hippo farming a thing, and much more!
